title: Training Orchestra
text1:
The Lentekrans Training Orchestra Linne, abbreviated LOL, is the orchestra where musicians are trained for the Grand Harmony. The LOL mainly consists of young musicians, possibly supported by older musicians from the Grand Harmony, just as LOL musicians support the musicians of the play group.
The main goal is to make music together in a responsible manner, but making friendships is also an important goal.
text2: Every beginning is difficult, and making music is no exception. We try to make it as smooth as possible for you. You join the play group when you have been playing an instrument for approximately 9 months. You make music together with musicians from the LOL. After a few months, you play longer and longer with the LOL so that after 1 year you can fully participate with the LOL. You start with half an hour and eventually you play 1.5 hours together.
text3: The LOL and the play group play 4 or 5 concerts per year. This can be in Linne, but it can also be that we are invited to another association or to, for example, D'n Daag van Lin. The LOL musicians also participate in the Saint Nicholas procession and in accompanying the communicants to church. There is a fun activity every year for the musicians of the play group and the LOL and every other year we go camping.
